Odisha Government Orders Probe into Textbook Errors

The Odisha government has ordered a Crime Branch investigation into errors found in school textbooks. This follows the suspension of four senior officers and the state's acknowledgment of 1,678 errors. The Chief Minister has directed the SCERT to file an FIR regarding the matter.
